title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents licensing distinctions that the briefing reports as unpublished. An Agent 365 licence is not required to open the app but is required to view third-party agent data, so the claim that administration time is the only known cost also needs correction. The roadmap facts and documented control paths and commands are supported.
